secrets.name: The Potting Shed
secrets.text: Behind the ivy, somebody keeps the seeds. The catalogue on the bench lists every flower in the glasshouse, and a few that have not come up yet.

meta.label: The Flower Index
meta.blurb: A glasshouse where the flowers are made of paper and every petal is printed. You could read a whole bed of them, if you knew what order to pick them in.
